title: Cofaidh, Ceòl 's Cabadaich
description:
Tha na seiseanan Cofaidh, Ceòl is Cabadaich againn air an cuir air dòigh gus coimhearsnachd na Gàidhlig, luchd-ionnsachaidh agus daoine aig a bheil ùidh sa chànan a thoirt còmhla airson ceòl beò, cupa tì no cofaidh, pìos cèic, agus cabadaich.

Tha fàilte ort ionnstramaid a thoirt leat agus pàirt a ghabhail ann an òran no dhà!

CHAN FHEUMAR TIOGAID A CHEANNACH - FAODAIDH SIBH NOCHDADH AIG A' CHULTARLANN.

NO NEED TO BOOK A TICKET - PLEASE JUST COME AT THE RELEVANT TIME.  ALL WELCOME.
address: Cultarlann Inbhir Nis, 68 Academy St, Inverness, IV1 1LP

title: Fèis nan Deideagan airson clann
description:
Fèis nan Dèideagan airson clann

Trobhad dhan Chultarlann airson Fèis nan Dèideagan!

This event will be in Gaelic for children with parents/guardians without Gaelic welcome to attend. All children must be supervised by an adult at all times. 

This event is for children (and adults) who want to play together and build a massive track layout, road network, route or otherwise, using their own toys. 

For example, children who have Thomas & Friends trainsets, Tomy (wooden track), Trackmaster, Hot Wheels track and toys and pretty much anything else, come together and we work as one large team to create the largest layout we can. 

Please bring your trainset, hot wheels track and anything similar. We will connect it all together in our hall to make the largest layout possible. 

All toys must be labelled and identifiable. 

Tablets, phones, screens and toys which make a lot of noise, are not permitted. No video games. This is for children who want to be actively involved in building a layout with current and new friends. 

All children must be in Gaelic medium education at primary school level.
address: Cultarlann Inbhir Nis, 68 Academy St, Inverness, IV1 1LP

title: Calum MacColl 's a chàirdean: Cèilidh 's dannsa
description:
Fàilte air Calum MacColl agus a chàirdean airson cèilidh aig Cultarlann Inbhir Nis. Bidh oidhche air leth againn le sàr cheòl, òrain agus dannsa. Oidhche Ghàidhealach fosgailte do dhuine sam bith.  

We re delighted to welcome Calum MacColl and friends to the Cultarlann for a Highland cèilidh full of music, song and dance. This will be a true Highland evening which is open to all and the splendid setting of Cultarlann Inbhir Nis.
address: Cultarlann Inbhir Nis, 68 Academy St, Inverness, IV1 1LP
